title: Check if an Array Is Consecutive
goal: Check whether distinct input values form one consecutive integer interval.
strategy: An interval with n distinct integers has maximum minus minimum equal to n minus one. Check both distinctness and span; span alone can hide duplicate values and missing interior values.

edgeCases: A duplicate hides a missing interior value
Distinct values with an interior gap fail the span test
